full_export: fantasy_current.json (same generated_at; full pools and history)
read_me: Bridge facts only; generated_at is when the data was pulled.
AVAILABILITY: a player is available in this league if and only if he is NOT listed in rostered_index. The 'available' lists are top-N samples, not the full pool.
rostered_index entries are 'Name POS NFL'. Same-name players differ by NFL team (match name + pos + nfl).
null means unknown, never zero.
Tables use cols + rows; match values to columns by position.

coverage: week 11 games posted (vs 1 in snap counts): PFR defense 0/1, PFR receiving 0/1, PFR rushing 0/1, play-by-play 1/1. A source with fewer games posted is partial for that week: its latest-game values are null for teams not yet posted.

usage: nflverse stats + PFR snaps, ok, thru wk 11, updated 2026-11-20T12:01+00:00; posts 1-2 days after games. thru wk = latest week with ANY game data (a Thursday game sets it); check each row's last_wk.
injury_report: official NFL report (nflverse), ok, wk 11, updated 2026-11-20T16:04+00:00.

usage_risers: available players up 10+ pts in snap % or target share (nflverse), ranked by score = snap % now + the rise, taken round-robin across position groups so no group crowds out the rest; Risers named in this run's Dynasty Nerds articles are kept ahead of the cap (a pointer, not evidence). 'total' = how many qualified before the cap. ESPN leagues include players outside ESPN's 350-player free-agent sample who are on no roster in this league.

usage cols snap_lg, tgt_share_lg (offense) and def_snap_lg (IDP): % in the player's latest game (week = last_wk); nflverse, same freshness as usage. Only on Rob's roster rows: available rows stop at last_wk (their spikes are flagged in usage_risers.basis).

IDP execution (PFR advanced defense via nflverse, ok, thru wk 10, updated 2026-11-19T18:02+00:00): on Rob's roster rows cols_idp adds tkl_share_l3 (% of his team's combined tackles), mtkl_l3 (missed tackles in each of his last 3 games, list, oldest first; null = that game not posted), mtkl_pct_l3 (missed / (missed + combined)), press_pg_l3, sacks_pg_l3, tgts_pg_l3 (times targeted in coverage), then latest-game tkl_lg, mtkl_lg, press_lg, tgts_lg. usage_risers.idp_exec = [tkl_share_l3, mtkl_pct_l3, press_pg_l3, sacks_pg_l3, tgts_pg_l3] for DL/LB/DB (null for offense). PFR posts 1-2 days after games and is often partial on Monday/Tuesday: a game without a PFR row is null (unknown), and averages use only games with a row.

Offense role & efficiency (play-by-play ok thru wk 11; PFR rec/rush ok): on Rob's roster rows cols_off adds ay_share_l3 (air-yards share %), rz_tgt_share_l3 / rz_car_share_l3 / gl_car_share_l3 (% of his team's targets and designed runs inside the 20 / carries inside the 5; scrambles, kneels and 2-pt tries excluded), rz_rush_l3 (his red-zone designed runs, total), td_l3 (rush + rec TDs, total), pa_pg_l3 (QB pass attempts; null for others), yac_pa_l3 (rush yards after contact per carry), btkl_l3 (broken tackles, total), drops_l3 (total), then rz_opps_lg (red-zone targets + carries, latest game). usage_risers.off_exec = [ay_share_l3, rz_tgt_share_l3, rz_car_share_l3, gl_car_share_l3, td_l3] for offense (null for IDP). Shares and totals use only the last-3 games already posted; a field with none is null.

usage_risers basis: 'l3' = last 3 games up 10+ pts vs the 3 before; 'spike' = latest game 15+ pts above his prior-3 average (snap % or target share); both = 'l3'. Noise floor: latest snap % >= 40, or target share >= 12% or 8+ carries that game (tuned on weeks 4-6).

vacated_roles (pool file): starters (team snap leader at RB/TE/LB/DL/DB, top 2 WR; last-3 snap % >= 60 offense / 80 defense) who are Out/Doubtful (official report, only when it is this week's) or IR/PUP (Sleeper), with the next 1-2 teammates by last-3 snap % (RBs also by carries) who played the team's latest game and weren't already full-time. load = carries_pg_l3 (RB), tgt_share_l3 (WR/TE), tackles_pg_l3 (IDP). available = not on a roster in this league (null = can't match). ok: report wk 11; Sleeper IR/PUP 254.

intel: '(Bluesky)' sources are posts; beat writers, Rotoworld and Rapoport are news (reports), the rest are analyst takes listed after news. This run read 49/49 accounts. Dormant (30+ days silent): joejhoyt.bsky.social, elliottteaford.bsky.social, popesffh.bsky.social, garydavenport.bsky.social.
intel: 'ESPN News' items are news-tier relays (mostly Rotowire, naming the original reporter in the text) for Rob's rostered players, last 72h. This run read 64/64 players.

standings (main): league table (seed, record, points for, ESPN playoff % where given; rob = true on Rob's row), playoff_teams, playoff_weeks, rob_seed and games_out_of_last_spot (0 = in a playoff spot). nfl_matchups (main): for each NFL team on Rob's roster, this week's opponent, home, implied_total (from the betting total and spread in nflverse schedules, ok), own_plays_pg and opp_plays_pg / opp_pass_rate (offensive plays per game and pass % over each team's last 4 games from play-by-play, thru wk 11), and playoff_opps = opponents in this league's fantasy playoff weeks. For IDP, more opponent plays and a run-heavy opponent mean more tackle chances. BYE = no game.

articles (pool) / articles_mine (main): Dynasty Nerds weekly articles from the last 8 days (RSS: main + category feeds, podcasts dropped), ok, fetched 2026-11-21T02:03:30+00:00. series = idp_waiver, idp_start_sit, waiver_faab, risers_fallers, trade_advice, rankings, cheatchart, injury_update, watchlist or other; week parsed from the title. names_* = players the title, summary or tags name (feeds carry no article text), split into Rob's roster and available in this league. Analyst tier: open the url for the reasoning; never treat as role, injury or availability evidence.
sl_proj: Sleeper's week 11 projection scored with this league's settings (Sleeper projections). League starters projected: offense 93/96, K 11/12, IDP 63/67. espn_* columns are ESPN-scored proxies.
standings: every team's record, points for/against and max PF with league ranks (Sleeper roster settings, same pull as generated_at).
Companion of fantasy_ai_sleeper.json (roster, matchup, injury report, intel). Match generated_at.

GitHub full copy: built with roomier lists (up to 25 available per position, 40 usage risers, intel text up to 300 characters) and no 24 KB trim; the Drive copy of this file is trimmed. Same generated_at and sources.

usage.note: Row column 'usage'; DL/LB/DB use cols_idp. % values; last 3 games played, oldest first; trend vs prior 3 (+/-5 pts). last_wk = week of the player's latest game in the data. No routes data; red-zone shares and efficiency on Rob's roster rows (see read_me).

available.note: Top 25 per position. Ranking: offense by FantasyCalc 1QB value; K and IDP (and unvalued offense) by ESPN rest-of-season projection from the ESPN leagues (ESPN-scored, matched by name + position, so a ranking aid only); then Sleeper search_rank. rank_by says which applied. Not the full pool; use rostered_index.

trending.note: Sleeper-wide adds over the last 24h (all Sleeper leagues, not this league): a hype signal, not usage. Only players confirmed available in this league are listed; players that could not be matched are left out. my_drops = Rob's players that Sleeper managers are dropping.
